_comment: COPY to .cursor/hooks.json (or merge the `hooks` key into an existing one). Cursor's beforeShellExecution payload carries the command as `command` at the top level rather than under `tool_input`, and expects {"permission": ...} instead of Claude's hookSpecificOutput — bash-guard.mjs detects both dialects and answers in the right one. THE EDIT TIER DOES NOT EXIST HERE: Cursor has no pre-edit hook (afterFileEdit runs after the write), so on Cursor only the shell guard and the git floor apply. Paths assume `add --agent cursor`, which puts the kit in .dev/kit/.
